moments.title: DIAGNOSTIC
lines: This reads the intrusion cold: its dominant routine, its threat tier. It never bluffs.
Configure your kit against the named tell before you dive, not after you meet it.

moments.title: OVER PAR
lines: PAR is the clean route, measured in rotations. You just spent past it.
A win still lands, but now it costs Neural Strain. Sloppy is survivable. It is not free.

moments.title: NEURAL STRAIN
lines: Strain is shared across every ticket today and will not recover between them. Zero ends the run.
It bills you for rotations past par, and separately for any of their traps that actually sprung on you.

moments.title: AUGMENT DRAFT
lines: Clearing a ticket offers three augments. Pick one and it holds for the rest of the run.
Three tickets a day, so a clean day banks three picks. CONFIG unlocks a mode, BOOST bends the economy. A full bay swaps instead of blocking.

moments.title: DAY CLOSED
lines: There is no second pick later. Choose the one that fixes what tonight's dive actually needed.

moments.title: NIGHT SHOP
lines: You can no longer choose a shape. DARKNET.LNK sells one blind pull, price climbing by the day.
Night patch still buys your strain back. Buy an extra boost bay tonight to raise your cap above 3.

moments.title: PATCH PIECE
lines: You are carrying a piece. Click a slag block within reach to fuse it in for 2 RAM. One use, then it is gone.
Arms land exactly as held, never rotating once placed. Fit it to the wall you cannot route around, not the first slag you see.

moments.title: BAY FULL
lines: Boost bays are full. Take this pick and you choose one installed boost to bench in its place.
CONFIGS never count against the cap and are never affected by a swap.

beats.line: Now watch it move. Watch what it plants.
It is holding back. It wants to see what you learned.
The grid is live. Your programs are still indexing; for now, click a glowing junction to rotate it (1 RAM). Line the pipes up and your signal floods forward on its own.
Chain rotations toward the CORE. When a junction clicks into line, everything connected claims at once. Spend your RAM, then END TURN.
It armed something on your lane last cycle. SCAN.EXE just came online: cast it (1 RAM) and it sweeps everything near your line. Always scan before you walk.
There it is. DEFEND.EXE is online, set to PURGE: cast it, click the exposed trap, and defuse the thing before your flood walks in.
The trap is gone but it WILL plant another. When one shows, DEFEND purges it. Keep pushing meanwhile.
Last program: ATTACK.EXE, set to REDIRECT. Cast it and click one of ITS junctions to twist its line off true. Make it hurt.
That is the whole toolbox: scan, defend, attack, rotate. Push for the core with everything you have.
